sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3784 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.118 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kaligiri Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act.

entities.text: Kaligiri Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the order dated 24.08.2020 passed in Criminal Petition No.3324 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the crime may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in Crime No.118 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kaligiri Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed; consequently, no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
_________________ JUSTICE D.RAMESH 10th September, 2020 Mjl/*
